Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24632
Date from the article (published Oct 19, 2026: 'Monday'). Suspected cyber incident; actor and action not identified, so actor unknown / action unknown and security_incident Suspected. Availability Interruption from the network being disabled. No confidentiality impact (no indication of data compromise): data_disclosure Unknown. Discovery internal Unknown. Employee count 10001 to 25000 (Parkview is roughly 15,000 staff; approximate).

summary: Parkview Health, a Fort Wayne, Indiana nonprofit health system with 16 hospitals and more than 300 outpatient sites in Indiana and northwest Ohio, proactively disabled its network after suspicious activity on Monday, October 19, 2026, taking down MyChart and online physician search. Parkview said there was no indication patient data had been compromised.
